user_questions: Do I need to replace them?
What is the lifespan of veneers?
voice_response:
With proper care, high-quality ceramic veneers can last many years — often 15 to 20 years or even longer.

The longevity depends on factors like your oral hygiene, diet, habits like teeth grinding, and regular check-ups. Your Authorized USD Smile Designer will guide you on how to care for your veneers to maximise their lifespan.

Think of them like a premium pair of shoes — with the right care, they stay beautiful for a very long time.

user_questions: How do I take care of veneers?
voice_response:
Caring for your veneers is very similar to caring for your natural teeth.

Brush twice daily, floss regularly, and visit your dentist for routine check-ups. Avoid biting extremely hard objects like ice or opening bottles with your teeth.

You can eat most foods normally. Your Authorized USD Smile Designer will give you specific care instructions based on your treatment.

user_questions: Am I too old for veneers?
Is it suitable for my age?
voice_response:
There's no upper age limit for smile designing. As long as your teeth and gums are healthy, you can benefit from USD treatment at any age.

For younger clients, we typically recommend waiting until jaw growth is complete, usually around 18 to 21 years, before considering veneers.

Your Authorized USD Smile Designer will evaluate your individual situation and recommend the right timing for your journey.

user_questions: Can I go back to my original teeth?
What if I don't want them anymore?
voice_response:
Traditional veneers require a small amount of tooth preparation, which means they are not fully reversible. However, minimal-preparation or no-preparation veneers may be an option depending on your case.

This is something your Authorized USD Smile Designer will discuss with you during the planning stage, so you can make a fully informed decision before treatment begins.
